purpose: assess whether real training question structures can expose the discovered generation padding-position mismatch, to inform CPO training design
data: first 32 training questions in stored order per each of three tasks, fixed batch 4, no labels
conditions: same training question template and image processor, seed42 shared stage1 checkpoint configuration, compare rope index positions against single-example preparation; no sampled rollout or gradient
metrics: only aggregate left padding, prefill position equality and mrope delta offsets
limits: consecutive order is not the actual training sampler, no evidence about actual historical training batches or causal training effects; CPU, one hour watchdog, 1GB cap
